fields.x_mm, y_mm: local metres x 1000, x east, y north, in the frame of public/data/slc/terrain.json
fields.flags: bit 0: placed by rule; bits 1-3: source id (sourceIds); bit 4: enclosed (under a bridge or in a tunnel; left out of lamp-cells)
fields.aim_cdeg: arm direction in hundredths of a degree as the source gives it (City of Las Vegas ROT_ANG); 65535 = unknown

note: The drive plan's tile pyramid (plan 02, 6.9) is deferred, so the layer is one file per city, to be cut into lamps/{L}/{x}/{y}.bin tiles when the pyramid exists.
